status.nb: 100 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 17 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Islamabad, Peshawar og Kabul.

summary.en: Security forces continued cross-border operations, killing infiltrators in Upper Kurram and arresting Afghan Taliban members in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, while a bomb-disposal officer was killed by an IED in Upper South Waziristan. A high-voltage cable fell on a house in Bahawalnagar, killing three members of the same family, and a bus-truck collision on the Hazara Motorway killed eight and injured thirty. Discussions focused on a possible strike on Iran’s nuclear facilities and the testing of Iran’s Hormuz agreement with Pakistan after an LNG tanker attack. The conflict still accounts for 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsstyrker fortsatte grenseoverskridende operasjoner, drepte infiltranter i Upper Kurram og arresterte afghanske Taliban-medlemmer i Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, mens en bombefjerningsoffiser ble drept av en IED i Upper South Waziristan. En høyspenningskabel falt på et hus i Bahawalnagar, og tre medlemmer av samme familie ble drept, og en kollisjon mellom buss og lastebil på Hazara-motorveien drepte åtte og såret tretti. Diskusjonene fokuserte på et mulig angrep på Irans atomfasiliteter og testing av Irans Hormuz-avtale med Pakistan etter et LNG-tankskipangrep. Konflikten står fortsatt for 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
